task: Find the latest Diffusion-related blog on Hugging Face, and read its intro or overview section to roughly summarize the content of the blog.
answer: The latest Diffusion-related blog on Hugging Face is "Waypoint-1.5: Higher-Fidelity Interactive Worlds for Everyday GPUs" (published April 9, 2026, at https://huggingface.co/blog/waypoint-1-5). Rough summary of its intro/overview: Waypoint-1.5 is Overworld's next real-time video world model, built to bring interactive generative worlds to hardware people actually own. Building on the first Waypoint release, it improves visual fidelity, expands the range of hardware that can run it locally, and moves toward interactive world simulation without datacenter-scale compute. On desktop GPUs (RTX 3090 through 5090) it generates real-time environments up to 720p at 60 FPS, while a new 360p tier targets broader consumer hardware such as gaming laptops and, soon, Apple Silicon Macs. Its biggest change is accessibility, offered through two model tiers. Trained on nearly 100x more data than Waypoint-1, it produces more coherent environments and more consistent motion over time using more efficient video modeling that reduces redundant computation across frames. It emphasizes responsiveness over raw fidelity, and can be experienced locally via the Overworld Biome desktop client or in the browser through Overworld Stream.
